主要内容: On June 4, 2018, Stanley M. Bergman, Chairman and CEO of Henry Schein, Inc., is scheduled to appear on CNBC’s Mad Money with Jim Cramer. Mr. Bergman may address the Company’s projected earnings growth for fiscal 2018, with a non-GAAP diluted EPS range of 12-15% compared to 2017 non-GAAP diluted EPS. The guidance excludes restructuring and spin-off/merger costs of the Animal Health business. A reconciliation to GAAP is not provided due to uncertainty in predicting non-GAAP adjustments. The Company also disclosed risks related to healthcare regulations, data privacy, cyberattacks, third-party dependence, litigation, and global operations, including joint ventures like Henry Schein One and the spin-off of its Animal Health business with Vets First Choice.
